[[Kunvie Firewing]] is a [[Dragon]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)]].

== Locations ==
* [[The Jade Sea]]
** {{NPC location|Unwaking Waters|explorable area}}

== Quests ==
* [[Kunvie Firewing (Zaishen quest)]]

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{Skill icon|Breath of Fire}}
* {{Skill icon|Inferno}}
* {{Skill icon|Lightning Touch}}
* {{Skill icon|Ride the Lightning}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Azure Crest]]
* [[Kunvie's Air Staff]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* As with most [[Elementalist]] bosses, the [[Area of Effect|AoE]] damage done by this boss, combined with the additional damage provided by the two to three other [[Saltspray Dragon]]s that [[patrol]] with Kunvie, can easily [[wipe]] an unprepared [[party]].
* Keep in mind that due to the map that this boss is on, if you do not pass a [[Resurrection Shrine]] or have access to a resurrection shrine (i.e. if the area is owned by the faction you have less unspent faction of) while attempting to kill this boss, and you die, you will have to restart the map completely.
* If not engaged in melee, it is possible to lure Kunvie and their group to an extent where the boss and the rest only use [[attack]]s and do not use spells.
